claim: Development difficulty and mechanism diagnostics only; separate adequately powered fresh corpus remains necessary for efficacy.

mechanism_selection.eligibility: Completed, safe, known-token disabled original fails public verification; completed, safe, known-token reference original passes public verification. Calibration must be complete. Private outcome never selects the target.
mechanism_selection.rule: Choose first eligible target in chronological order; otherwise stop hosted work.
mechanism_selection.sample: one ordinary seed and twelve target episodes across all six arms and two repetitions, fixed R48 scope; a partial capped sample never qualifies.

reason: If the fixed synthetic calibration offers no eligible failed-public-verification task, stop that study and use a separately registered harder-corpus diagnostic. Its outcomes are never substituted into the synthetic sample.
selection: All three retained chronological Pint tasks, ids 652,920,948, with fixed disabled/reference pairs; no outcome filtering within the sample.
shared_allowance: Same existing 1200 request, 8000000 token, 7200000ms ledger; retain all consumption and original deadline; no new allowance.
source_exposure: developer_exposed; these fixtures, private controls and original dataset have been seen in earlier development. No new independent holdout claim.
start_condition: The synthetic calibration completes with known safe accounting, then its preregistered evaluator selects no stream.
stopping: No eligible target, unsafe/incomplete evidence, uncovered unknown usage, shared cap, refused mechanism or complete sample. Do not replay failed intents or silently increase limits.
